column2: Changes creature's current power to zero
column3: Outdated for a creature whose power was raised before the ability resolved (ruling 2005-11-01): under the layer rules then in force (CR current as of 2005-10-01, 418.5a: sublayer '(6b) all other effects not specifically applied in 6c, 6d, or 6e' held effects that set and effects from spells and abilities that modify power and toughness, applied in timestamp order) setting the power to 0 overrode an earlier +3/+3; since the M10 CR (effective 2009-07-11, 612.3b-c; today 613.4b-c) effects that set power apply before all effects that modify it, so an earlier pump still applies (Oracle: 'has base power 0'). The rest stays cited: power 0 for a creature not pumped before, and later pumps raise it. Logged in docs/RULING_DISCREPANCIES.md.
